name: SikaProof® Sandwich Tape
tagline: Double-sided adhesive overlap tape for the SikaProof A+ waterproofing system
summary: SikaProof® Sandwich Tape is a double-sided adhesive tape based on a polyacrylic adhesive sandwiched between release liners.
metaDescription: SikaProof® Sandwich Tape is a double-sided adhesive tape based on a polyacrylic adhesive sandwiched between release liners.
usage: Sealing and bonding of overlap joints and details within the SikaProof® A+ membrane system
packaging: 5 rolls packed in one cardboard box Individual roll size | Length: 25 m Width: 50 mm

items.label: APPROVALS / CERTIFICATES
items.text: Watertightness of a Surface Sealing System SikaProof® A+ 12 / SikaProof® Sandwich Tape, WISSBAU, Test report No. 2018-276

items.label: Storage conditions
items.text: Product must be stored in original unopened and undamaged sealed packaging in dry conditions and temperatures between +5 °C and +30 °C. Always refer to packaging.

items.label: System structure
items.text: SikaProof® Sandwich Tape is a system component for sealing overlap joints of the SikaProof® A+ membrane system. For more detailed information, refer to Sika® Method Statement: SikaProof® A+ System

items.label: Compatibility
items.text:
For materials in direct contact (such as any synthetics etc.) the compatibility must be evaluated before full project application.
Contact Sika® Technical Services for more information.

items.label: SUBSTRATE QUALITY
items.text: The contact surfaces must be dry, clean and free of materials that could impair the adhesion. Contaminants, such as dirt, dust, oil, bitumen and de-bonding agents, such as surfactants and silicones must be removed.

rel.t: SHEET WATERPROOFING MEMBRANE for BASEMENTs AND TUNNELs
rel.s: Sikaplan® WP 1100-30 HL is a flexible, homogeneous sheet waterproofing membrane with a signal layer, based on premium-quality polyvinylchloride (PVC-P).
a: High resistance to ageing
Based on virgin material with consistent quality
Without DEHP (DOP) plasticisers
With signal layer to indicate damages
Optimized flexibility, tensile strength and multi-axial elongation

rel.t: Sheet waterproofing membrane for basements and tunnels
rel.s: Sikaplan® WP 1100-31 HL2 is a flexible, homogeneous sheet waterproofing membrane with a ≤ 0.2 mm thick signal layer, based on premium-quality polyvinylchloride (PVC-P).
a: High resistance to ageing
Based on virgin material with consistent quality
Without DEHP (DOP) plasticisers
With thin signal layer to indicate damages
Optimized flexibility, tensile strength and multi-axial elongation

rel.s: Sikaplan® WP Protection Sheet-15 HE is a homogeneous protective membrane with an embossed surface, based on polyvinylchloride (PVC-p).
a: Embossed surface to allow proper spreading of repair injection material
High resistance to mechanical influences
Without DEHP (DOP) plasticisers
High dimensional stability under permanent pressure and heat
Flexible at cold temperatures

rel.t: FPO sheet membrane for pre-applied fully bonded below ground waterproofing
rel.s: SikaProof® A+ 12 is a polyolefin (FPO) based sheet membrane for below ground waterproofing of reinforced concrete structures. It is loose laid onto prepared substrates or formwork
a: Pre-applied: Fixed before placing reinforcement and casting concrete
Dual bond: Mechanical and adhesive bond with fresh concrete
High flexibility and crack-bridging capabilities
No lateral water migration between the concrete structure and the membrane system
High watertightness tested according to various standards
